verdicts.reason: A has the wrong reading order: the 'Find It Near You' CTA sits at the very top, above the headline, and the SOLSTICE wordmark has dropped below the headline. The two badges are stacked at very different sizes, so 'Back by Demand' looks like a second, competing button. The phone runs nearly edge to edge and the green circle is mostly gone. B keeps the headline first with the CTA right after the tagline, which reads better. But SOLSTICE is still stuck under the headline, and both badges are blown up into full-width pills as big as the CTA. The bright yellow 'Summer Only' pill at the bottom pulls more attention than the CTA does. The right column is cramped with almost no gap between rows.
